name: retry-decision
description: Determine whether to retry a failed operation or give up based on error type and attempt count

options.description: Retry the operation - the error is likely transient or recoverable
Stop retrying - the error is persistent or further attempts are unlikely to succeed

evaluation_factors: Nature of the error (transient vs permanent)
Expected probability of success on next attempt

metadata.purpose: Bounded retry decisions via JEV semantic matching
